# Main information📙
The AetherisVanilla was created for Server Aetheris. Unlike other modpacks on which this modpack is built, it contains mods recommended for use on this server.

# Features ❓
1. [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)
2. [Emotecraft](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emotecraft)
3. Many other cool mods.

# 🤔 Why this modpack?
Your choice is yours, and I don't want to force you to use my modpack, but I'll appreciate your support and downloads. This modpack has the best optimization pack, which gives the best results on every server/singleworld.

# About the server
Aetheris is a vanilla Minecraft server with unique, handcrafted mechanics that seamlessly integrate with familiar gameplay. Here, you'll find a well-developed storyline and lore, with players able to either participate in or observe events from the sidelines. The server regularly hosts events, quests, and competitions, and considers player ideas for further development.

# Основная информация📙
AetherisVanilla был создан для Сервера Aetheris. В отличие от других модпаков, на основе которых он создан, этот модпак содержит моды, рекомендованные для использования на этом сервере.
